description: Return next-N playback bootstrap metadata for short-form feed prefetch (WS12 Phase 8 / ADR 0037). Product-surface metadata only; does not alter manifest identity or segment addressing.

main.description: Given ordered video at-uris (typically the next window of a feed), return one playbackBootstrap per item in a single response.

uris.description: Ordered tools.garazyk.video at-uris to bootstrap. Clients should pass at most the prefetch window (default 2).

windowSize.description: Number of items returned (≤ requested uris).

wasteCeilingBytes.description: Upper bound on bytes prefetched but never played if the user swipes past the entire window (sum of firstSegmentBytes, clamped by server policy).
